text: I am kindly asking for your support of my motion to traffic calming along Forest Hill Road, between St. Clair Avenue West to Heath Street West. Residents of Forest Hill Road submitted a petition to my office requesting the installation of speed humps to help reduce speeding, discourage cut-through traffic and improve the safety of their street. With the passage of this motion, the community will receive the traffic calming measures they have been organizing for.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (two speed humps) on Forest Hill Road, between St. Clair Avenue West to Heath Street West, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 6, 2026) from Councillor Josh Matlow.
